versions.changelog:
Initial release — Version 1.0.0 of Super Middle Manager Academy

- Provides a structured management skill framework tailored for middle managers, covering self, team, work, and strategic management.
- Includes practical tools and actionable methods derived from the 8-book "超级中层商学院" series.
- Features detailed guides on communication, mindset, cross-department collaboration, execution, planning, team leadership, role development, and work methodology.
- Offers step-by-step frameworks and real-world scenarios for over 90% of common middle management situations.
